estimates.assumptions: 1 cup dry yellow split peas weighs ~196g (standard volume-to-weight conversion for dry split peas).
1 medium cabbage head (edible portion) estimated at ~2 lbs / 908 g; common average for a whole head after removing outer leaves/core.
6 medium carrots estimated at ~61 g each (standard medium carrot weight without tops), total 366 g edible.
1 large turnip (rutabaga) estimated at ~300 g peeled/edible portion; typical size for a large root vegetable in this context.
8 medium potatoes estimated at ~150 g each (standard medium potato), total 1200 g raw edible weight (skin-on as typical for boiling).
Modest 'to taste' amount for black pepper estimated at ~2 g (roughly 1/2 tsp ground); standard modest seasoning quantity for entire large pot.
